title: Great & Underrated app
text:
I love this app for many reasons. It isn’t magical but it is practical for my neurospicy brain that it feels like it. I love the way it starts with a visual deep breath. 

You set up your own routines as
detailed or as broadly as you need. Or try templates at first. Morning routine, skin care, work  arrival, etc. Whatever routine 

You can have the app vocally narrate the routine, telling you “2 remaining for brush teeth then drink lemon water.” You can skip steps, you can rearrange the order in real time so that on the days where you can’t drink lemon water as your next task you move it to the end so that you still get prompted to do it later. And it doesn’t permanently change the order, just lets today be different. And you can still skip it later in the routine but at least you tried to see if the lemon water might happen after getting dressed. 

This really has helped me habit stack and internalize some groups of actions in ways that head knowledge cannot. But where I may also forever need prompts, this is enjoyable and comforting and motivating. It tells me where I am with timing of tasks so I can both go with the flow but not lose track of my schedule.  It gives tutorials to help automate the start up of the app with my iPhone alarm. 

You do have to do your part and start the ball rolling in some way. If you don’t use it and keep adapting it as you use it then it won’t do you any good. But it has many really useful elements that make it better than setting a million alarms and reminders.

title: 결국 결제함
text:
최고의 루틴앱입니다.
4년 전부터 이 앱을 써보고 간헐적으로 쓰다가
올해 새해를 맞아 큰맘 먹고 연간결제를 했는데
너무 좋은 선택이었어요. 아침, 준비, 저녁 등등 다양하게 활용하고 있는데 삶이 정돈된 느낌이 들어서 참 좋네요.
자신만의 생활루틴을 만들고 싶으신 분들께 강추드립니다.

피드백이 있다면, 맥북에서 사용할 때 가끔 튕기는 현상이 나타납니다. 잠시 멈춤 버튼이나 할일추가 버튼 등을 누르는 등 루틴을 중단했다가 다시 실행할 때, 어떤 버튼을 눌러도 실행이 안되는 케이스가 있습니다. 
또 하나는 루틴을 실행할 때 세부 루틴의 고정된시간 자체를 아예 수정할 수 있었음 좋겠어요. 하다보니까 아 생각보다 양치질은 3분이 아니라 5분이 필요하네 싶을 때 수정하고 싶은데, 바로 수정하지 못해서 뭔가 아쉬워요.

이런 부분만 수정된다면 더욱 완벽할 것 같아요. 계속 잘 쓰겠습니다. 좋은 앱 만들어 주셔서 진심으로 감사해요 :)

title: Perfect tool for adulting with Multiple Sclerosis & depression
text:
I was confused about the promotional offer when I got this app and contacted customer service. I got a very thoughtful email from the CEO completely addressing my concerns and asking for any other feedback. I provided one other request for a tweak to an app feature and received another thoughtful response from the CEO. I’m very pleased with the customer service. 

This app helps me like no other app, book, plan, or strategy has been able to do. I struggle with time blindness (losing track of time) and being a time wizard with a broken wand (having no idea how long it actually takes to finish tasks and WAY underestimating). I also have lots of anxiety and motivation but difficulty with task initiation (I want to start, know it’s important, but transitioning from one thing to another or from stopped to moving is REALLY difficult). This app HELPS!

1. My morning routine starts automatically when I turn off my alarm. The first task has a timer on it so I don’t have time to dawdle or hurkle-durkle. I’m pressured to get up and get going. 

2. If I don’t finish a task in the routine within the time limit, it reminds me, aloud, that time is up for that task and I need to move on to the next thing. It will remind me again in another minute, and five minutes after, and ten minutes after. It does not let me off the hook to just wander off task and forget what I’m supposed to be doing. If I’m not doing what I’m supposed to be doing, it is at least a deliberate choice now. 

3. At the end of the routines, it shows how long it ACTUALLY took me to complete each task so I can get a realistic idea of how long muggles take to get ready in the morning (which is important since apparently my wand is broken and I can’t magically shower, get dressed, gather my things, and get in the car all in an instant).

4. Once I’ve entered all the tasks into my routine with a start time, it shows me the finishing time so I know when I’ll really be ready and if I need to get up earlier.

5. Most importantly though is that since every task has a timer on it I feel a sense of pressure to keep moving forward which helps IMMENSELY with task initiation, motivation, staying on task, working quickly, and goal achievement. 

6. I do like that there is a checklist option for items that don’t fit into a routine but that need to be done at some point.

title: Useless app / steals your money
text:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD. DO NOT AGREE TO FREE TRIAL.

I downloaded the app after reading the reviews because I wanted something to help add structure to my mornings. I signed up for the 7-day free trial with the understanding that I’d either cancel before the trial ended or be charged after the 7 days.

Instead, when I opened the app, it asked me to log in if I already had an account. I entered my email and it said I did have one (I must’ve tried this app a long time ago). The second my login went through, it charged me the full YEAR fee immediately.

I did not agree to pay for a full year. I was not warned that logging into an old account would automatically trigger a full annual charge. I never received the free trial I signed up for — I was charged without my approval.

I contacted Apple for a refund literally within minutes of the charge (my bank alerted me almost instantly), and they still refused to refund it even after I explained exactly what happened.

The app is still as useless as it was the first time I tried it — except now I’m forced to pay for a full year of something I don’t want and won’t use, and no one will reimburse me.

This is NOT a case of me forgetting to cancel after the trial. I was charged immediately without consent because I logged into an old account. Misleading and shady.

Save your money. Use Apple Reminders or an app like TickTick instead. DO NOT download.

text: 잘 쓰고 있는데 개선점이 필요해서 건의합니다. 예를 들어 어제 루틴을 하다가 중간에 멈췄고 오늘 다시 앱을 켜면 어제 것부터 이어서 하게 됩니다. 전 이게 싫은데 루틴 처음부터 하는 걸 선택할 수 있게 바꿔주세요. 또 이것과 관련된 건데, 어제 하던 루틴이 켜져서 종료를 누르면 이게 오늘 루틴이 종료된 걸로 인식됩니다. 그래서 오늘 루틴을 하려면 다시 초기화해서 시작해야 해요. 이런 과정이 너무 불편합니다. 개선해주세요.
author: J I
developer_reply:
불편을 드려 정말 죄송합니다. 많이 답답하셨을 것 같아요.

말씀 주신 상황은 '프로필 탭 > 설정 > 시스템 설정 > 하루 종료 시간' 기준으로 하루 기록이 정리되는 방식과 관련이 있을 수 있어서, 재현해 보고 개선하려고 합니다.

가능하실 때 아래 내용만 간단히 알려주실 수 있을까요? 짧게 적어주셔도 충분합니다.

1.루틴을 멈추셨을 당시 화면 상태(타이머 일시정지인지 루틴 목록 화면인지 등)
2.루틴을 멈춘 시간과 다시 열어보신 시간(대략)
3.설정된 '하루 종료 시간' 설정값

번거로우시겠지만 프로필 탭 > Support > 이메일 문의를 통해 보내주시면, 원인을 파악해 불편이 반복되지 않도록 개선하겠습니다💛

title: Gone downhill.
text: Recently I’ve had a really terrible experience with this app. It never works right for me. The voice settings randomly switch back and forth from beeps to voice, sometimes it will give me “five minutes until”, sometimes not…the whole point of this app is to make it effortless to help with my routines. I literally spent an entire “routine” trying to adjust my settings on my iPhone, accessibility, widgets, enabled notifications, making sure everything is updated, checking that I wasn’t on “focus” mode…. Nothing worked. The voice alarm settings are wildly inconsistent. Even if there is something I’m missing, I shouldn’t have to go on a whole wild goose chase through my phone. I held off writing this review because I wanted to make sure I was being fair and it wasn’t something I was doing on my end but…literally the voice settings change within the same routine, even if I delete the history and run it again, they will be wildly different the second time around. Awful. If you have ADHD and are looking for a helper app, this is not the one. It has sabotaged me multiple times this week. Which is sad, because it used to work great.

title: New update is cluttered.
text:
When running a routine, the bottom of the timer screen is now cluttered with the voice assistant, auto-next, context and white noise settings. I would appreciate if the visibility of these could be toggled in settings. 

I’ve also had issues regarding the alarm notification feature; when I open the app it will often only show the pulsating routinery icon and has to be force closed.

As a final niggle, apps such as TickTick allow users to edit what is visible in the tab bar. This feature would make the user experience far more enjoyable in the long run for those who are looking for a simple routine creator app, as opposed to a social app.

I do really appreciate the app, and am aware the problems are relatively small and fixable. But at the moment the app interface makes the subscription somewhat difficult to justify.

title: Can’t do without it, but glitchy
text:
I’ve used this app for years and I completely depend on it for managing and planning my days. It’s odd for me to stick with an app for any length of time but this has proven to be the exception. For maybe the first time in my life I have consistent routines that I stick to. The whole concept just really works for my brain. 

They’re continually improving the app and user experience. Also the developers really listen to and implement feedback and if you reach out for support they’re professional, friendly, and prompt. 

I absolutely love this app and hope it never fundamentally changes.

My only complaint at the moment: PLEASE PLEASE FIX THE WATCH APP. I know it was recently updated and it’s come a long way but I rely on it and it’s so glitchy. And the communication between the watch and phone app is so poor. It will regularly just stop mid routine on the watch, completely skip steps, completing the routine on the watch doesn’t register in the app messing with streaks, and the app will say a routine is running on the watch when it isn’t. Please fix these glitches and get the phone and watch apps to run in sync!!

title: Work in Progress Habits
text:
I’ve been using Routinery to help restructure my mornings, and as someone who is highly sensitive to overstimulation, I have found it to be a very helpful tool for managing my daily energy.
What I appreciate most is the sequential flow. Instead of feeling overwhelmed by a long list of tasks, the app guides me through one step at a time. It acts as a gentle pacer, which is essential when I’m trying to transition into my workday without feeling drained before I even arrive. It provides a sense of structure that helps me stay grounded when my routine starts to slip.
Overall, it is a great resource for anyone who needs to protect their morning routine and maintain a steady pace throughout the day.
I truly enjoyed using this to build a peaceful morning habit. It is perfect for someone who values slow mornings and wants to focus on healthy habits that provide peace of mind. I was even finding success with my evening routines. Unfortunately, because of the subscription constraints, I am unable to build an afternoon routine, which is a disappointing barrier.
While this is a great tool in theory, I am not pleased with the cost restrictions. I hope to return to the app in the future if there is a way to use it without a financial barrier, but for now, the subscription prevents me from fully integrating it into my life.

title: 절대꺼지지않는 소름끼치는 푸쉬알람
text:
맨 아래가 원래 썻던 리뷰고 그 위에 중간꺼는 불편해서 삭제했었다가 업데이트 됐다고 해서 오랜만에 다시 깔고 씀 쓴 리뷰에요

그리고 이건 다시깐지 이틀만에 앱 삭제한 이유인데요..
경조사가 있어서 하루 나갔다왔는데 와 알람끄기하고 루틴 건너뛰기하고 그래도 안되서 루틴했다고 거짓체크까지 해도 푸쉬알람이 계속옴 . 심지어 루틴세운거 다 삭제까지 했는데도 앱오류인지뭔지 계속 루틴할시간이라고 푸쉬알림을 분마다 보내더라고요;; 100개 넘게외서 진심으로 무서웠고 휴대폰 밧데리 나갔어요 이거때문에.
뭔짓을해도 푸쉬알림을 끌수가없어서 소름끼쳐서 바로 지웠어요 
1년365일 매일 경조사도 약속도 이벤트도 하나도없이 세상을 혼자서만 사는 기계인간만 써야하는 어플인듯…

——————
26년 5월 리뷰
업데이트 후 불편했던게 싹다 개선되고 루틴 순서도 수정되고 자동으로 넘어가지기도하고 너무좋아요 움하하하하 !!!!

——————-
2025년에 원래 썼던 리뷰
안녕하세요 이제 막 다운받아서 쓰기 시작했는데요, 1. 루틴 설정해둔거 그날그날 상황에 맞게 유동성적으로 변경은 안되나요? 예를들면 제가 원래는 11시에 강의 듣기를 루틴 설정 해두었는데, 오늘은 점심 약속이 있어서 11시에 준비하고 나가야하거든요. 그래서 강의듣기 건너뛰기를 하고 싶은데, 어플에는 정지 아니면 완료 표시밖에 못 찾겠어서 너무 불편해요.. 오늘은 강의를 안 들을 예정이니 체크표시는 안 남기고 싶은데 강제로 체크표시 남겨져서 찝찝해요…  2. 그리고 알림없이 바로 다음 루틴으로 넘어가는 설정도 루틴 실행 후 바로 변경 가능하면 좋겠어요. 루틴을 한 번 재생하면 타이머 종료 후 자동으로 다음루틴 재생하고 싶어도 바로 설정이 안되고 완료 누르고 밖으로 나가서 수정한 다음에 다시 재생 눌러야해서 좀 불편해요. 건너뛰기가 필요 없는 날을 위해서 또 다시 매 번 수정해야하고.. 불편합니다ㅠ 예를 들면 강의 듣기 전 단어 복습 30분 루틴을 설정했는데, 습관화가 안되면 복습을 까먹을 수 있으니 루틴 알람은 디폴트로 해두고 싶거든요. 그런데 어떤 날은 복습할 걸 기억하고 강의 들으러 가면서 복습할 자료를 챙겨가서, 복습 끝나고 바로 강의를 듣는 날이 있을 수 있잖아요? 그러면 복습 끝나자마자 바로 강의 들을 수 있게 ‘타이머 종료후 자동으로 넘어가기‘를 하고 싶은데, 자동으로 안넘어가지니까 강의 듣다가 중간에 타이머 울려서 끄러가야하고 공부 집중하다가 맥끊겨서 오히려 루틴 어플이 방해가되요. 타이머랑 같이 루틴 설정해두고 지킬 수 있게 도와주는 건 좋은데 유동적이지 못해서 실용성이 떨어지는 것 같아요ㅠㅠ 두가지 기능이 개선되면 좋겠어요

text: A YouTube video I was watching suggested the app. I have crippling ADHD and bipolar and am trying to get my life back from the absolute depths it fell to. I have no concept of how long things take and usually get off task and morning routine is out the window. Today I did a morning routine! I’ve never had a routine! I love that I can actually see how long each step takes so I can adjust later. It was also great to see the things I naturally do every morning that I needed to add in to my routine. So excited to work with this and make different routines so I can just click and automate without thinking! Thank you!

title: Love it, customer service is great too
text:
While I only use this app when I’m truly struggling, I’m super happy with this app.

It’s helped me with burnout recovery, ADHD time blindness (had no idea how much time I actually have in a day before getting this app!) and completing tasks which would take a lot longer for me to complete usually. 

I’ve set up various routines such as: 
> Morning, dinner, night routines
> Chores and errands
> Getting ready for a night out
> Packing for a holiday
> Unpacking from a holiday 
> Getting my room neater in 5 mins AM/PM
> Fast morning/night routines 
> Make up routine 
> Exercise/Cool down routines
> Pep talk routine (I created a 5 min routine where each ‘task’ is actually a positive statements for 5 seconds, like ‘you’re not a bird in a cage!’ ‘Burn that negative thought, put it in the bin! Amazing for my burn out recovery, when I need a boost, and to help me regulate my emotions)

Endless because it’s all up to you and t
 
Easy to duplicate, delete and archive routines 
There are routines people have shared that you can also copy to your own list of routines

Love that you can choose to allow a task to move to the next automatically. There’s plenty of background sounds.
 
Various features I love, especially LOVE the new calendar feature where you can visually see each routine for the day stacked in a calendar/day format. 

LOVE that the developers are continuously improving! Love that the founder responds to emails the MOST. Super happy with this app. 

Suggestions (maybe considered already):
- Varied voices to be added since I only see 1 voice I can use 
- Tutorials 
- Seamless looping of background sounds 
- Battery drains very fast on devices so would like to see that improve. If you forget to switch a routine off, it will continue in the background (as designed) so for us forgetful lot, it would be helpful to have a prompt after 20 mins or so to remind us that ‘fyi, this routine is still working in the background, do you want still want to finish this routine or end it?’ 
- iPhone and Mac user but longer routines are draining my battery fast

title: Super happy with this app!
text:
It’s helped with my burnout recovery, ADHD time blindness and completing tasks which would take a lot longer for me to complete usually. I had no idea how much time I actually have in a day before downloading this app and regularly using it!

Love:
> that it’s easy to duplicate, delete and archive routines 
> that there are routines people have shared that you can use as inspo or directly copy to your own list 
> that you can share your routine publicly with other users
> that you can choose to allow a task to move to the next automatically. There’s plenty of background sounds.
> the various features
> the calendar feature where you can visually see each routine for the day stacked up against the calendar / in a day format. 
> that the developers are continuously improving! Love it the most that the founder responds to emails! 
> that you can use it across devices - but do make sure you’re signed in to all devices using the same log ins and update the app regularly - otherwise the routines won’t sync properly across devices e.g. when you edit a task on one device 

I’ve set up various routines such as: 
> Morning, dinner, night routines
> Chores and errands
> Getting ready for a night out
> Packing for a holiday
> Unpacking from a holiday
> Getting my room neater in 5 mins AM/PM
> Faster morning/night routines 
> Exercise/Cool down routines
> Pep talk routine (I created a 5 min routine where each ‘task’ is actually a positive statements for 5 seconds, like ‘you’re not a bird in a cage!’ ‘Burn that negative thought, put it in the bin! Amazing for my burn out recovery, when I need a boost, and to help me regulate my emotions)
List is endless  

Suggestions for improvements (maybe considered already):
> Seamless looping of background sounds 
> Varied voices in the voice setting options. I only see 1 voice on my device and I find robotic voices jarring sometimes. I tried changing the voice to a natural voice via iPhone’s main text to voice settings but not sure it works like that 
> Video tutorials (YT Shorts preferably) especially following updates and for new features, FAQs
> I’m an Phone and Mac user, but it seems the app is draining my battery fast  - If you forget to switch a routine off, it continues in the background (as designed, so it’s fair!). For us forgetful people, it would help to have a prompt after inactivity to remind us ‘hey, fyi, this routine is still working in the background, are you still completing the routine or do you want to end it?

title: It’s great. Pay them for their hard work if you find it useful.
text: NOTE: being mad an app isn’t free is like being mad restaurants aren’t free or your plumber isn’t free. I guarantee you that hundreds, if not thousands of hours went into making this app, and it’s updated constantly… which means they’re working on it all the time. If you value someone’s work, you should pay them for it. Having a concentration app shoving ads in your face constantly worlds kind of defeat the purpose, no? Regarding the app: I needed a relatively simple app to break my day into blocks of repeatable tasks (e.g. morning routine) and blocks of time where I could use my existing task management tools to get things done. This app is great for that. Not as rigid as Tiimo time-wise but it’s heavier on reminders. Tiimo ended up being a place where I could see whatever it was that I’d been falling to work on for the past hour… this does a better job of keeping me on track. Support (might be a one person project?) is responsive and useful. Syncing for the watch is excellent while in a routine (another thing Tiimo was terrible at)    -Wishes- Base Functionality: * Halfway reminders, or reminders every 𝑛 minutes would be super useful. While I’m working, I use an interval timer app that gives me a simple notification every six minutes. Having this integrated would be helpful. * would love a mode where I had a pile of tasks and a set block of time and I could choose which ones to do next. Sometimes it doesn’t matter if I shave before a brush my teeth but just need to be reminded to do both and stay on task. UI improvements: * Having text search of emoji would help. Doesn’t have to be any more complicated than a filter based on characters included in the name. Figuring out whether the icon I want is in default or whatever can be tedious. “Wait… was there a work category? No? Maybe electronics? No… hmmm” * Having sub-headings or details under title for tasks would be helpful. * Still not really sure what contexts are. My first guess is that they’d be like GTD contexts like “on the phone,” or “at work,” but that doesn’t really make sense for a scheduled task. Maybe that’s not the right word for the functionality? If so, some other wording could use cleanup— “you can restart at any time” implies that you’re starting from the beginning. Unless I’m not seeing the ability to restart, it should read “you can continue any time.” In think there are a few other minor ones but clearly not important enough to matter. * Would love to see a breakdown of how much time I allocated to each task in reality so I can adjust my schedule or habits. That is more important info to me than whether or not I completed the entire block exactly as prescribed. Thanks for making the app.

title: Completely worth it. Amazing app for ADHD brains
text: This app is one of the most useful tools I've ever used to combat procrastination and other ADHD related difficulties. I love how flexible it is to be able to adapt to what I specifically need. I especially love that I can skip a part of my routine and it still marks the entire routine as completed (you can see in the details what you skipped). This is a big deal for me because it removes the feeling of missing something and the guilt that could entail. People often say "just start" but it feels like every part of a bigger task needs that decision to start. With this app, I just need to decide to start the routine, the rest is decided. It's gotten me to be more consistent with my workouts (I just added 15 minutes of yoga to the end of my morning routine) and with my studies. But I use it for anything I do regularly that involves more than two sequential actions. The big thing is, YOU need to decide start. The app can remind you, but only you have the power to take that action. But once you've done that, the app (and your past self who created the routine) removes the decision fatigue from the rest of that routine. I seriously and wholeheartedly recommend this app!

title: Best routine/habit app!
text:
A beautiful brain created this app. It’s clean, smooth, and seamlessly functional between phone and watch. Perfectly balanced between the powerful flexible features without complicating anything. 10/10

Here’s how I use it:
Long routine I set the moment I get up that flows me through my morning. Timed tasks like exercise are set, while flexible tasks are skippable once completed, with waiting periods until the appropriate times. (I actually have moments in my morning where I can pause and breathe!)

My skincare routine, changes nightly but so does my layout with different days customised with each step in order. It even auto starts at the right time. My skin’s never been clearer.

My weekly planning/archiving routine is now flawless. I never forget to check emails, lay out my weekly budget, or tick off that one small habit. It goes down to seconds for each task, and if tasks are on my phone, it’s also right there on my watch. What a godsend.

I also use it at work to time tasks because once completed, the statistics show how far off I was for each task. Unbelievably powerful data alongside my other health data metrics.
author: Pylot9468

title: Great for Time Blindness / Morning Scatteredness!
text:
For years, I’ve been looking for an app like this. I’ve always been known to run late, and as the years have passed, because of this, I think I have more anxiety and scatteredness in the mornings. This has helped me figure out a realistic routine or days. I have to go into the office versus days that I work from home and just supports consistency. It also takes a lot of the guess work out of what you need to do and what order how much time you have to spend on each task, and that is invaluable so that you can just have a peaceful morning routine. I also love the fact that you can see which tasks you docked not enough time for versus too much and continue to adjust the routine accordingly, so that it is realistic and helps you to plan your life better. So grateful for this.

Update: great to use to get consistency and a flow, until things become automatic habits. 

Also helps with time blocking for cleaning, house projects, etc if you tend to underestimate how much time something will take. 

KEEPS ME ON TRACK. I LOVE THIS APP!!! Totally worth it!

title: 4 weeks no skipped gym days
text:
I bought this to help nail down my exercise habit. 
I'm extremely busy and driving to a gym to exercise just felt completely unfeasible. I did have to wrangle with my schedule for about two weeks before I figured out when I could actually go to the gym consistently.  then I built two gym routinery routines because two days I go in the morning and two days I go in the afternoon.
Now four weeks later I haven't missed a single gym day. Each of the gym routines which support me getting ready and actually driving are exactly what I needed to fill that gap and making the choice that I wanted to make.

Per la prima volta mi fido della mia affidabilità. Ha davvero cambiato la mia vita. Suggerisco l’abbonamento perché ci vuole tempo per costruire routine personalizzate e l’abbonamento non ha restrizioni sulla quantità di routine (ne ho tantissime adesso, non solo per la mattina, per gli appuntamenti, ma anche per per le pulizie, per i progetti, per la cura personale, per la cura dei miei cani) Anche se l’italiano non c’è ancora come lingua, metto le mie routine, la descrizione delle ‘task’ in italiano (e va bene così) anche se immagino che l’italiano arriverà eventualmente.
